scope_team_id.meaning: the team whose material this is, which bounds what may be derived from it

training_authorized.meaning: explicit permission to train on this material; never inferred from permission to read it

derivation_type.meaning: how it was derived; an adapter is not a base model

parent_model_id.meaning: the model it was derived from

parent_revision.meaning: the parent revision it was derived from; without this the derivation is not reproducible

snapshot_id.meaning: the training material used, for derivations that used any
